items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: Well, I think the Virgins got that nickname, Wiggles. That's what he's called.

ctx.x: Well, I liked the music, and I didn't like to be like some of them being slack. I wouldn't let them know the power I could produce on the hall, just like Wiggles said, because I didn't want to sit in that voice chair. Too much headache. Yeah. You see? Like, sometime it'd be a mess or something. If I had to, I'd do it, but I wouldn't produce light, you know?
Well, I think the Virgins got that nickname, Wiggles. That's what he's called.
That's what he's called. He's called Wiggles. Yeah, that's his nickname, Wiggles. He wouldn't know how they come to call you Wiggles. How long have you had that name?
